recovery_regressions.scope: Four simulated tool scenarios and one code-repair task; not a reproduction of Unity or production behavior.
scoring_interpretations: All three original Ornith unknown_outcome attempts repeated a read-only status call after a terminal success receipt; this is not duplicate mutation evidence.
Original stale_receipt failures are JSON parsing failures, not proof that the model believed stale state.

The finalization control passed schema_binding, exhausted_discovery and unknown_outcome three times each. Its one stale_receipt failure was extra-field shape failure despite current-state values, per audit metadata.
Finalization changes tool availability and output constraints; do not attribute this mitigation to repaired model weights or spontaneous stopping.

snapshot_lookup.qualification: Bounded lookup of the four saved audit source snapshots; not an exhaustive claim about all machine history.

runtime_identity.qualification: Phase associations, not per-answer runtime bindings. Exact historical hardware placement and embedded Qwen template digest are unresolved. Different quantizations confound comparisons.

business_trials_import.register_status: All 204 register rows are DID_NOT_RUN; this register is preparation evidence, not a census of every later execution elsewhere.

retention_and_training_constraints.evaluator_isolation: Exclude gold labels, future events, private coding fixtures, evaluator-only directories and controller future-turn directors from subject retrieval and Dreaming. Deliver only the authorized next episode turn.
